snippet.title: Inanimate Insanity: Sweet Memories (CREEPYPASTA GAME)
snippet.description:
Introducing a brand new II creepypasta game! Play it here: https://asharp.itch.io/iism

After MePhone recovered his memories last episode, things haven't been the same. Complete this episode's challenge and get to the bottom of the mysterious disappearances at Hotel OJ...
[CW: themes of abuse / self harm]

The game takes about an hour to beat. Make sure to play in the dark and happy Halloween season! Post your playthrough and send it to me if you're into that, I'd love to hear your opinions and reactions! :D



Game, music, art, story, and trailer all made by me.
#inanimateinsanity #inanimateinsanityii #osc #mephone4 #suitcaseii #lightbulbii #baseballii #animationepic
